proposals.title: Train directly on Brier loss (custom objective for GBMs)
proposals.description: Training with squared-error-on-probabilities (Brier loss) instead of log-loss produced best calibrated probabilities (0.1589 Brier on NCAA holdout). CatBoost and XGBoost both support custom loss natively. Apply to meta-learner in GBM ensemble.
proposals.implementation: Verify S14 xgboost_brier already uses Brier loss. If not, set XGBoost objective to squared-error on calibrated probability outputs. Also test on S22 meta-layer.

proposals.title: SHAP-filtered feature pruning before meta-stacking
proposals.description: SHAP to prune features before meta-stacking reduces calibration noise. With 200-feature cap, aggressive SHAP-based selection directly targets Brier improvement. Low-risk, no new dependencies.
proposals.implementation: In evolution island mutate(), compute SHAP values on held-out val set and zero out features with |mean SHAP| < 0.001 threshold before GA selection phase. Combine with existing MAX_FEATURES=200 cap.

proposals.title: MC Dropout RNN as uncertainty-aware meta-learner
proposals.source: MDPI Information 2026 — Uncertainty-Aware ML for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
proposals.description: RNN + Monte Carlo Dropout as stacking layer over existing GBM predictions. Absorbs temporal/sequential signal (rolling form, shot embeddings) that tree models miss. Produces calibrated uncertainty per prediction.
proposals.implementation: Add 1-layer GRU meta-learner with MC Dropout (n=20 passes) on top of S13/S22 base probability outputs. Requires GPU — target Colab T4 or Modal A10G burst. Not compatible with CPU-only islands.

recommended_next_action: Verify S14 xgboost_brier uses true Brier loss objective (HIGH priority, zero infra cost). Then add SHAP gate to S13 mutation cycle.
